_note: ReportSchema (analytics report, ADR-0021 single-form). Live path: objectui ReportRenderer → DatasetReportRenderer (dataset-bound). Seeded from docs/audits/2026-06-reportschema-property-liveness.md and re-verified against objectui HEAD — the audit's `chart` = DEAD finding is superseded: DatasetReportRenderer's DatasetReportChart now plots `chart.xAxis`/`yAxis` (dataset dimension/measure) via useDatasetRows (framework#1890/#3441), so `chart` is LIVE (only its `groupBy` sub-key stays experimental, per its own describe marker). objectui paths cited as prose in `note` (not `evidence`, which resolves framework file:line). Framework provenance/lock fields (protection/_lock*) auto-classify live (ADR-0010). 2026-07-30: the aria/performance entries were STALE — the keys had already been removed from the schema in the report-liveness close-out; deleted as ledger hygiene.

name.note: report identity — metadata key + objectui ReportRenderer.

type.note: objectui: DatasetReportRenderer routes tabular/summary/matrix (cross-tab + server totals) / joined.

dataset.note: objectui: DatasetReportRenderer binds the semantic-layer dataset (ADR-0021); superRefine requires dataset+values for non-joined reports.

rows.note: objectui: dataset dimension names grouped down — DatasetReportRenderer.

columns.note: objectui: matrix across-dimensions (rows × columns pivot) — DatasetReportRenderer.

values.note: objectui: dataset measure names — DatasetReportRenderer; required (superRefine).

runtimeFilter.note: objectui: render-time scope filter ANDed at query time (`?? filter`, mergeFilters) — DatasetReportRenderer.

order.note: framework#3916. Authored ordering, most significant key first; each `by` names a `rows`/`columns` dimension or a `values` measure the report selects (validated by the schema's superRefine; a `joined` report orders per block). `reportSelectionOrder` lowers the list to `DatasetSelection.order` and the executor applies it over the ASSEMBLED grid — after measure-scoped filters merge, `__compare` columns attach and derived measures evaluate — so a derived measure is a valid sort key. objectui: `DatasetReportRenderer`'s `useDatasetRows` (the single fetch choke point) carries it onto the posted selection across all four paths — grouped table, embedded chart, matrix cross-tab, per joined block — with `readOrder` lowering and `scopeOrder` narrowing it to each sub-selection, plus the ordering in the refetch signature (objectui#2964). Flipped from `planned` + authorWarn once that landed. Separate and independently live: a selected TIME dimension defaults to ascending server-side, so month/quarter matrix columns are chronological with no `order` declared at all.

drilldown.note: objectui: DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:697 — click-through to underlying records (default on; set false to disable).

chart.note: objectui: DatasetReportChart plots `chart.xAxis` (dataset dimension) × `chart.yAxis` (measure) via useDatasetRows, honoring `type`/`title` (framework#1890/#3441). Supersedes the 2026-06 audit's DEAD finding. Sub-key `groupBy` stays experimental (its own describe marker) — the dataset renderer plots a single series and never reads it. Live on NON-joined reports only (#20161, re-read at the `.objectui-sha` pin f8a9d0fb): the one `report.chart` read (DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:1557) sits after the joined branch's return (:1462-1524), so on a `type: 'joined'` report the schema's refinement REFUSES `chart` rather than accepting a key nothing reads. A `joined` report draws no chart (packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts, the joined-chart prescription, #20161; read point moved out of spec source, #23434): at objectui @f8a9d0fb0596 packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx#DatasetReportRenderer the joined branch draws each block as a `DatasetMatrixTable` / `DatasetReportTable` and returns before the one `report.chart` read, and no renderer reads a block's `chart`.

dateRange.authorHint: Keep it, but nothing reads it yet: the Console report page draws no date-range chip, so the report still shows every period until the report renderer reads this key.
dateRange.note: PLANNED RECORD (#26548, the spec half of ruling 6408567749 on #25873, letter B). The report period `{ dimension?, defaultRange, allowCustomRange }`: `defaultRange` / `allowCustomRange` are the dashboard declaration verbatim (DATE_RANGE_DEFAULT_RANGES, defaults this_month / true, held equal by report-date-range-export.test.ts); `dimension` names a dataset dimension that declares `type: date` (omitted = the dataset declares exactly one). The four dataset-aware cases are judged by the `@objectstack/lint` rule validate-report-date-range.ts at os validate / os build and at the report publish door. Refused on a `joined` container. PLANNED, not live: no renderer reads it. The report page posts its selection through `useDatasetRows` in ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx#DatasetReportRenderer with no `timeDimensions` entry, and no source under ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ names `dateRange` (0 hits outside tests). The renderer contract is the TSDoc on `ReportSchema.dateRange`: the active window rides `selection.timeDimensions: [{ dimension, dateRange }]` with no `granularity` (a filter window ANDed with `runtimeFilter`), which the analytics service already accepts. Carrier: #25873, the ui renderer card, Blocked-by this one. Flip to `live` on the commit that cites the renderer read point, and drop `authorWarn` / `authorHint` in that same edit.

dimension.note: The dataset dimension the window applies to. Planned with its container: no renderer reads it. Its dataset-aware checks are live in lint (validate-report-date-range.ts: unknown, not a date, omitted with several date dimensions, omitted with none).

defaultRange.note: The preset the report opens on, the dashboard declaration verbatim. Planned with its container: no renderer reads it.

allowCustomRange.note: Whether the viewer may pick a custom range, the dashboard declaration verbatim. Planned with its container: no renderer reads it.

exportOptions.note: #25873 (ruling 6408567749, letter B; spec half #26548). The report export control `{ formats?, includeHeaders?, fileNamePrefix? }`: three members of the list export block (ReportExportOptionsSchema in packages/spec/src/ui/list-view-export-options.ts), formats `csv` / `xlsx` only, on by default (absent = both, `formats: []` = off). Refused on a `joined` container, and not read there. LIVE: a non-joined report draws an Export control (ReportExport.tsx#ReportExportControl, read from DatasetReportRenderer.tsx#DatasetReportRenderer as `report.exportOptions`) once its table has rows. The download is the table AS DRAWN: the grouped table or the matrix cross-tab hands the cells it renders, server totals included, up through ReportExport.tsx#ReportTableSnapshotContext, so the file carries the active `runtimeFilter` and period of the table's own query and nothing is re-queried or re-aggregated. Who may export is NOT a report key: the control is offered only when the viewer's effective apiOperations on the dataset base object (the query answer's `object`) include `export` (ObjectPermission.allowExport, the predicate the list toolbar uses, read through `@object-ui/permissions` usePermissions); an absent operation set (no provider, an unrestricted object) keeps it, as on the list. Both files are written in the browser: the list XLSX path is the server record stream, which cannot carry aggregated report rows, so the XLSX is built with ExcelJS imported only when asked for. Pinned by ui/packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.export-25873.test.tsx.

formats.note: The formats the control offers, in the declared order; absent = csv and xlsx, `[]` draws no control.

includeHeaders.note: Whether the download opens with the table's header row (dimension and measure labels as drawn); absent = true.

fileNamePrefix.note: Replaces the report label as the file name base; the name is built by `@object-ui/core` buildExportFileName (base-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.ext, the list export's builder).

blocks.note: objectui: joined-report sub-reports, each dataset-bound — DatasetReportRenderer joined branch (:1462-1524 at the `.objectui-sha` pin f8a9d0fb) reads a block's dataset/rows/columns/values/runtimeFilter/order/type/label/description/name and draws it as a table. A block has NO chart: `chart` was removed from JoinedReportBlockSchema in #20161 because no renderer ever read it (`block.chart`: zero hits over objectui packages/ at the pin, against a lit `block.runtimeFilter` control). A block with no `dataset` (packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts joinedBlockDatasetRequired, #21702; read point moved out of spec source, #23434): at objectui @ab1879721595 packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx#DatasetReportRenderer the joined branch hands each block's dataset to its table as `String(block.dataset ?? '')` and the table's query hook goes idle on an empty name; a report whose blocks all lack one fails objectui @ab1879721595 packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx#isDatasetReport and falls through to the pre-9.0 presentation bridge, which queries nothing.
